sources.title: gpt2-xl: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Default settings often need adjustment to balance coherence and diversity. How it compares gpt2 is the base 124M parameter model, roughly 12 times smaller than gpt2-xl. Use the base model if you need faster inference, lower memory requirements, and acceptable quality for simple text completion tasks.
